policies.title: Turkish ordinary passports: visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Türkiye's current MFA table explicitly records the listed ordinary Turkish passports as visa-free for the stated short visitor scope.
conditions: Palestinian access is stated visa-free by the destination, but the MFA says Turkish citizens normally need an Israeli visa to reach it; the Egypt-to-Gaza exception is separate.
Syria is visa-free according to the MFA table, but ordinary-passport holders pay a border fee on arrival; the fee is not a visa-on-arrival classification.
Tunisia and Ukraine are visa-free up to 90 days; Bosnia and Herzegovina is visa-free for no more than 90 days in 180; Panama is visa-free for three months.
This does not establish residence, work, special-document, route, security or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Türkiye ordinary passports: Djibouti eVisa
policies.summary: Türkiye's MFA says ordinary Turkish passport holders are visa-subject and may travel to Djibouti with an eVisa obtained through the named official service.
conditions: The policy is limited to the MFA-described ordinary-passport tourist route; it does not establish visa on arrival, work, residence, transit, or special-document access.
The MFA separately lists service, special and diplomatic passport holders as visa-free for up to 90 days.

application.label: Djibouti official eVisa service
steps: Apply for the eVisa before travel through the official service named by Türkiye's MFA.

policies.title: Türkiye ordinary passports: Comoros and Sudan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Türkiye's current MFA table expressly says that ordinary Turkish passport holders may obtain visas at the border in Comoros and Sudan.
conditions: Comoros: the MFA says ordinary passports are visa-subject and visas can be obtained at border posts.
Sudan: the MFA says ordinary, service and special passport holders are visa-subject and visitors may obtain visas at all Sudanese border posts.
This establishes only the stated short-visitor border-visa route, not eVisa, residence, work, transit, special-document or final-admission treatment.
